tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Hiring For SAP Hybris Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Hybris Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & Spring
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) for storefront and third-party consumers, and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Platform Operations & OMS
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine, Hotfolders, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: Data & CI/CD Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, enabling me to start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud and Java experience to your team, contributing to robust enterprise e-commerce architectures, seamless third-party integrations, and optimized backend performance.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to deliver scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions leveraging strong Java and Spring expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am currently based in Karlsruhe and available from 16.12.2026. I would love to discuss your SAP Hybris Developer opening.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the SAP Hybris Developer position. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your engineering team. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
